Today, Apple's Instagram page posted a carousel showcasing works shot specifically for the iPhone Duo cameras by photographers Jake Michaels and Jason Nocito. Details below.

Apple shares six 'Shot on iPhone Duo' photos

For the past decade, Apple has been showcasing the camera capabilities of each new iPhone through its 'Shot on iPhone' campaign.

From everyday users to renowned photographers and filmmakers, Apple has used the campaign to promote various new camera hardware, shooting modes, and other iPhone-exclusive photography features.

The long-running campaign has also won multiple awards at the Cannes Lions Festival of Creativity, including two Grand Prix, and has received two Emmy nominations for 'Outstanding Commercial.'

Apple today posted a new carousel on Instagram showcasing the iPhone Duo's 'versatile camera system packed with a range of exciting new features.'

Below are the six works shot by photographers Jake Michaels and Jason Nocito:

The iPhone Duo features a 48-megapixel rear camera, a 12-megapixel front camera, and a built-in under-display FaceTime camera. Pre-orders begin Friday, October 16, with shipping and in-store availability starting October 23.

Apple previously announced that customers can prepare for iPhone Duo pre-orders starting October 12. Learn more here.
